label: Property master (parcel, address, owner, zoning)
note: Simulated subscriber departments. None of these systems is built; each row shows what one shared property master would give a department. Every signal is synthetic.

subscribers.contract_text: Reads parcel identity, owner, use and valuation to prepare assessment notices. Writes nothing back to the property master.
Reads parcel use, units and flood zone to plan inspections and pre-incident plans. Writes nothing back.
Reads parcel owner and zoning to route complaints to the right owner and code section. Writes nothing back.
Reads the official address and unit list to match service accounts to a parcel. Writes nothing back.
